mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Verona City Hall with a temperature of 61 degrees. The moon is in its first quarter, and we are expecting an overnight low of 60 degrees with rain predicted for the overnight hours.

Starting September 23, the city will begin chip seal road treatments. Work zones include parts of Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue, so please expect lane closures between 9 AM and 3 PM. Additionally, the City Plan Commission will review several development projects, including sites on Country View Court and Davis Hill Drive, during their October 5 meeting.

There is plenty happening around town, starting with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival tomorrow. You can also visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Square tomorrow or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In a report covering late August through mid-September, police noted an incident on September 5 where officers found several vehicles with cheese on their windshields, believed to be part of a viral social media prank.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for the night. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow when the store reopens at 10:00 AM with a new flavor of the day.
